facts.text: Regional Council Item 9.2 for January 29, 2019: substantial alteration of municipally registered heritage properties at 1478, 1480, 1484 and 1494 Carlton Street, Halifax. The application is by a developer company named on p.1.

Staff recommendation: approve substantial alteration of each of the four properties. At the Heritage Advisory Committee's December 12, 2018 meeting, parts 1-3 were approved, part 4 (1494 Carlton Street, removal of an attached structure) was defeated, and an alternative motion was approved for 1494.
The staff report states that other changes 'will address building code and life-safety issues, as well as internal renovations'.

Heritage impact statement (Spring Garden West HIS, Attachment A): intent to 'utilize the building's existing sprinkler system and the Nova Scotia Building Code's Schedule D Alternate Compliance, item #21, to eliminate the need for a second means of egress for the upper units'.

HIS project schedule: a Building Code Analysis will address 'the potential proposed means of alternative compliance for existing building re-use'. It is to be reviewed with City staff and to form the basis for permit and construction documents.
Attachments listed: Map 1; Attachment A (HIS, 1478-1494 Carlton Street); Attachment B (heritage building summary); Attachment C.
